general.name: Docker - Containers Differ From Expected [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when an expected Docker container is stopped or gone (including when Docker is stopped), Docker does not answer within 40 seconds, a stopped container is waiting to be removed by the prune, the host's prune is out of date, or the list has gone unreviewed for usrUnreviewedAfterDays; reports unlisted containers, aged from when first seen. Never starts a stopped Docker; writes only its first-seen file. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrMissingAction
variables.description: What an expected container that is stopped or gone does: Alert, or Warn (named in the status only).

variables.name: usrUnlistedAction
variables.description: What a running container not on the list, or any container with unreadable Compose labels, does: Warn (named in the status only), Alert, or Ignore.

variables.name: usrUnlistedAfterHours
variables.description: 0-8760. An unlisted container only counts once this long has passed since the monitor first saw it running; a restart or a redeploy does not reset that. Keeps upgrades and short tests quiet.

variables.name: usrStalePruneAction
variables.description: What a host whose installed prune is out of date does (no version stamp, older than this monitor wants, or the version 1 service that runs docker directly): Alert, Warn (named in the status only), or Ignore. The fix is to run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on the host.

variables.name: usrPendingRemovalAction
variables.description: What a stopped container the prune has recorded for removal does: Alert (default), Warn (named in the status only), or Ignore. One whose key matches an ignore pattern is counted but never alerts. Add it to the list to keep it.

variables.name: usrUnreviewedAction
variables.description: What a list nobody has confirmed yet does: Warn (named in the status, and an alert once the list is usrUnreviewedAfterDays old), Alert, or Ignore. Until review, stopped or missing containers do not alert.

variables.name: usrUnreviewedAfterDays
variables.description: 0-365. Under usrUnreviewedAction Warn, a list still unreviewed this many days after it was created or last changed alerts. 0 never alerts.
